g.text: Each panel has its own axes. SC16 always uses 16 responses; adaptive methods stop early.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: Primary seed 42; PGM mixture at its dev-selected threshold. Output tokens include both answer-extraction passes and exclude input processing and the teacher-forcing feature pass.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: In-domain Omni-MATH heads are fitted on Omni-MATH; transfer panels apply each model's saved MATH policy to the same Omni test responses.
